'''Mepha'as Prime''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Mepha'as Prime system/Legends|Mepha'as Prime system]], a part of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] before<ref name="Journal5" /> the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star/Legends|battle station]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jin-Jin]] won nearly half a million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Journal5" /> while [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Arenas of Mepha'as Prime]], which he then invested into real estate on Alderaan.<ref name="Journal5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mepha'as Prime was first introduced as part of the name of the Arenas of Mepha'as Prime in "[[Smugglers of the Outer Rim]]," an article written by [[Doug Shuler]] and published in the [[February]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Journal5" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' subsequently established Mepha'as Prime as a distinct astronomical object,<ref name="CSWE" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Mepha'as Prime [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA Mepha'as" />
